cells 4-8: detached animation PARTS as described for this character below. Every populated cell has exactly ONE object, all edges and tips safely inside that cell, no crossing cell boundaries. Empty cells must be truly alpha-transparent.

All parts exactly match body texture and lighting. No painted magic, no particles, no scenery or shadows on background, no text, watermark, numbers, borders or extraneous characters. Genuine RGBA alpha in empty areas.
